findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Rated life (L70)
findings.detail: LED estimated useful life of at least 50,000 hours at 70 percent lumen maintenance, from IES LM-80 data.
findings.why_it_matters: Without confirmed long life, we risk early failures and extra maintenance costs in office spaces.

findings.title: Warranty
findings.detail: Package states 5 years; spec requires at least 5 yr.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: DLC listing
findings.detail: Listed as a qualified DLC product, where applicable.
findings.why_it_matters: Missing DLC verification could mean lost rebates and uncertainty about energy efficiency claims.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: macadam steps
findings.detail: LEDs shall be binned within a maximum 3-step MacAdam Ellipse.
findings.why_it_matters: Unverified color binning may lead to noticeable light color differences between fixtures, affecting visual comfort.

findings.title: Couldn't confirm: Dims down to
findings.detail: Continuous dimming from 100 to 5 percent without flicker.
findings.why_it_matters: If dimming doesn’t work smoothly down to 5%, occupants may experience flicker or limited control, reducing usability.

findings.title: Product is discontinued
findings.detail: The manufacturer lists it as discontinued.
findings.why_it_matters: A discontinued product can’t be sourced for this job or future repairs, causing delays and compatibility issues.
